correctness.rationale: The omitted set has exact mass A=sigma(n)-2n. Positivity gives d+n/d<=A for each omitted nonsquare pair; the quadratic roots give the band. Under sigma(n)<=3n, A<=n<n+1 forces (1,n), and the cited Theorem 5 gives every positive power. Exhaustive integer subset-sum verification establishes the exact first escape at 720 and checks its witness.
